# LAME MP3 encoder

This website uses the unmodified `lame.min.js` browser bundle from [lamejs](https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs), version 1.2.1, by Alex Zhukov.

Lamejs is derived from LAME through jump3r. LAME project: <https://lame.sourceforge.net/>.

Upstream source and license: <https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs>. The upstream license notice is retained in `lame.LICENSE`. The bundle remains a separate JavaScript file and has not been modified.

The application converts valid PCM teacher audio to MP3 locally for media playback. Invalid pulse-only or silent speech outputs are rejected before conversion.
